chronoseries: 1/1 Holocene extant; scale comparison rather than a fossil predecessor

scale_neighbors.predecessor_meaning: beta-carotene monomer long axis, below a collective wavenumber
scale_neighbors.this_meaning: fastest-mode Turing pigment stripe inside one eyespot globule

parameters.note: Not the slot-195 template (alpha_scale 1.63, beta_offset 0.43, int_a 14, int_b 10, int_c 140).

specimen.artist: Dartmouth Electron Microscope Facility, Dartmouth College

measurements.name: selected_pigment_stripe_nm
measurements.method: Radial FFT of the linear-regime FD field vs analytical argmax sigma(k), scaled so lambda(k_max ref)=10.32 nm. RMSE of the Dv sweep is reported separately.

measurements.name: dispersion_pearson_r
measurements.method: Pearson r of numerical vs analytical fastest wavelength across the Dv sweep. Ideal correlation is 1; the finite-difference value is not identical.

measurements.name: dispersion_rmse_nm
measurements.method: RMSE between numerical and analytical lambda(k_max) over Dv in {18,24,32,36,44,58,76}.

measurements.name: saturated_vs_linear_wavelength_nm
measurements.method: Nonlinear saturated wavelength vs the linear-regime wavelength at Dv=36. The shift is the second parameter regime (above onset).

measurements.name: negative_control_sigma_max
measurements.method: Negative control: Dv=Du removes differential diffusion. sigma_max must stay negative (no Turing stripe).

measurements.name: ablation_sigma_max
measurements.method: Ablation: drop autocatalysis u^2 v, leaving linear decay. sigma_max must stay negative.

measurements.name: specimen_cell_diameter_um
measurements.method: Median equivalent diameter of isolated SEM cell bodies between 3 and 12 um, using the labeled 10 um scale bar. Debris and the merged cluster are excluded. Reference 10 um is the nominal vegetative length, not this bright-cap measurement.

measurements.name: specimen_cell_diameter_cv
measurements.method: CV of segmented cell equivalent diameters on the Dartmouth SEM. Zero would mean identical cells.

measurements.name: specimen_foreground_fraction
measurements.method: Foreground fraction of the modulated simulation frame vs the real SEM segmentation. Self-referential equality is not expected once the activator rescales edges.

measurements.name: specimen_structure_tensor_coherency
measurements.method: Structure-tensor coherency on the simulation mask vs the specimen mask.

measurements.name: specimen_contour_circularity
measurements.method: 4*pi*area/perimeter^2 of the segmented cell union, simulation vs specimen.

measurements.name: specimen_intensity_ks
measurements.method: Two-sample KS statistic between SEM and modulated cell-interior intensities (p=2.4e-11). Identical images would score 0.

measurements.name: onset_k_c_per_nm
measurements.method: Onset wavenumber k_c compared with the fastest mode k_max at Dv/Du=36. They differ above onset; lambda(k_max) is the 10.32 nm stripe.
